title.narrative: Building Trust in Media in South East Europe: Support to Journalism as a Public Good

description.narrative:
The project focuses on:


  1. enhancing the commitment and capacities of media and journalists to abide by professional and ethical standards of journalism and enhancing media accountability;
  2. reinforcing freedom of expression and circulation of accurate information by an increasing rights-based regulation of digital platforms and online media;
  3. adopting Media and Information Literacy (MIL) policies and integrating MIL in formal education to support the MIL skills of citizens, notably youth, to think critically;
